latestVersion.changelog: Production-hardened gateway watchdog. Auto-detect port, graduated health checks (CLI + HTTP), escalating repairs (restart → doctor → optional safe rollback with git stash), Telegram + Discord alerts, daily snapshots, launchd/systemd install. Born from auditing myclaw-guardian — fixed 7 critical issues including dangerous git reset --hard, fragile process detection, and missing alert passthrough.
